meta.title: Accommodation | Villa Mandara
meta.description: Rent the whole of Villa Mandara — 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms (2 indoor and 2 outdoor), up to 9 guests, pool and sauna, in complete privacy. In-season and off-season rates.

hero.title: Villa Mandara, entirely yours
hero.lead: The whole villa just for your group — 4 bedrooms, 2 indoor and 2 outdoor bathrooms, up to 9 guests, a pool, a sauna and common areas in complete privacy. The villa is rented as a whole, not by the room.

villa.title: The whole villa — just for you
